sources.title: Site Moves and Migrations - Google Search Central
claims: Google recommends mapping old URLs to corresponding new URLs, updating internal links and canonical references, and including new URLs in the sitemap.
Google advises avoiding redirect chains and redirecting to the final destination directly when possible; redirect chains add latency, and not all browsers and user agents support long chains.
Google recommends server-side permanent redirects when technically possible and testing redirect behavior.

sources.title: Redirects and Google Search - Google Search Central
claims: Google distinguishes permanent and temporary redirects and recommends permanent server-side redirects when a URL has moved permanently and that behavior is appropriate.
Google lists URL Inspection and command-line or script checks as ways to test redirects.

status: Official Google Search Central site move and redirect guidance reviewed September24; avoids traffic guarantees and directs implementation decisions to the site administrator.
